definition: Sliding-window one-step latent MSE (visual + proprio tokens, action dims excluded) on the most recent five executed transitions, the criterion of the logged AdaJEPA/Ours adaptation loss.
mode: Predictor and encoder in training mode as in the logged adaptation loss; dropout draws use fixed diagnostic seeds (new draws, not recovered from any run). Buffers restored after every forward; eval_mode_loss is the deterministic eval-mode value.
